accepted_findings.claim: src/_pytest/pathlib.py puts a samefile_nofollow implementation detail in the docstring instead of a code comment.

evidence_receipt.claim: src/_pytest/pathlib.py puts a samefile_nofollow implementation detail in the docstring instead of a code comment.
evidence_receipt.expected_stdout_contains:
On Windows st_ino is the file ID, which file systems are free to not
support, in which case it is 0 for every file -- WinFsp mounts such as
sshfs-win are one example. os.path.samestat() would then consider any two
files on the volume to be the same (python/cpython#78116), so a zero file
ID is treated as "unknown", leaving the caller with plain path comparison
like on the other platforms (#14864).
evidence_receipt.falsification_condition: Implementation detail about st_ino and file ID is in docstring, not a code comment.

verification_result.reason: AR does not use external verification.
